test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The compound interest (compounding annually) on a certain sum for 2 years at the rate of 60 percent per annum is Rs. 6240. What will be the simple interest on the same sum for 3 years at the same rate of interest?
solution:
**Given**

Compound interest (CI) = Rs. 6240

Time for CI (n1) = 2 years

Rate of interest (R) = 60% per annum

Time for simple interest (n2) = 3 years

**Formula**

CI/SI = 1 + R/200 (for only 2 years)

SI = PRT/100

**Solution:**

CI/SI = 1 + R/200

6240/SI = 1 + 60/200

SI = 4800

So SI for 2 years = 4800

SI = PRT/100

4800 = (P × 60 × 2)/100

P = 4000

SI for 3 years

SI = (4000 × 60 × 3)/100 = 7200.

**Therefore, the simple interest on the same sum for 3 years at the same rate of interest is Rs. 7200.**
